predicate: Jin'do summoned Hakkar's physical presence into Azeroth at Zul'Gurub
value: During WoW Classic, Jin'do the Hexxer summoned Hakkar the Soulflayer into Azeroth at Zul'Gurub. The Burning Crusade manual distinguishes this later physical return from the avatar summoned in the Sunken Temple.
editorNote: The two sources support a later physical manifestation after the Sunken Temple avatar. No cited source establishes the Ancient Egg as the cause or instrument of Jin'do's rite.
